notes:
High-level: mid-market product analytics SaaS evaluating Redwood after 6-week hosted API trial. Primary goal: move critical chat and embeddings workloads to Dedicated for predictable latency & cost. Team is pragmatic about model selection (open weights acceptable) but strict on SSO/KMS + audit logs.

Trial summary: short trial with ~3k monthly active agents, used hosted_api for chat and embeddings. Observed 95th latency 220ms on hosted, happy with quality, cost higher than target at current unbatched calls. POC asked for Dedicated sizing + traffic forecast.

Quote highlights from PO: "Need SLAs and clear cost predictability; cannot have noisy neighbor spikes impacting SLAs." Wants model fallback policy to smaller quantized model under high load.

Key constraints: must support VPC peering for staging, encryption keys in customer KMS, 12-month retention audit logs for compliance. Data residency preference: US, with EU for EU customers.

Pricing convo: asked for committed discount tiers (3/6/12 month) and predictable token pricing per model family. Focused on blended unit economics across chat vs embeddings. Finance requested a mock invoice.

Technical ask from infra: detailed QPS/concurrency profile + token mix, example SDK config for batching, and guidance on prefix caching for common system prompts. Also wants expected GPU count per shard at 2048 token context.

Internal sentiment: product team loves latency/response quality; platform/infra cautious about ops maturity and network peering. AE pushing Dedicated pilot as next proof point.
